items.title: Chambal Q2 FY27: consolidated PAT down 2.6%; Rs 5 interim dividend; new urea plant prep 'advanced'
items.text: Chambal reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of Rs 6,999.5 crore (+9.1% YoY) and net profit attributable to owners of Rs 631.9 crore (-2.6% from Rs 648.8 crore), with EBITDA margin at 12.8% versus 13.9%; the IMACID JV posted a loss of INR 31 million versus a INR 470 million profit a year earlier. The board declared an interim dividend of Rs 5 per share. Per Investing.com, pre-project work for the new NIPU-2026 urea plant (land, site enabling, environmental clearance, preliminary engineering) is in advanced stages, with completion subject to Department of Fertilizers and board approvals, and management is in ongoing discussions on the Gadepan-III benefit, which Investing.com says expires at end-November 2026. No cost, bid or approval timing was given, so the plant's go-ahead remains a pending catalyst.
